text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan is expected to tender for 54,000 tonnes of soybeans this week while demand for corn will remain sluggish following the outbreak in March of hog foot-and-month disease, traders said.

SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador was retendering for about 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes U.S. soybean meal in bulk under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. export agent said. The soymeal was set for June 1-15 delivery. Offers were to submitted no later than May 12 and will be valid until May 13.

FLOUR TENDER - Yemen has launched a May 13 import tender for 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat flour, European traders said. The tender calls for shipment between August and October and the flour is expected to come from the European Union, the United States or both, they said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 tonnes HRW wheat. The first shipment was for May 22-June 5 if from the U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second shipment was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, the Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
WHEAT TENDER - Pakistan will receive offers for its approximate 330,000-tonne soft white wheat tender on Tuesday, according to a Pakistan embassy official and several U.S. exporters.

"We are receiving the offers tomorrow (Tuesday)," the embassy spokesman said, speaking from his Washington D.C., office. The amount was about 330,000 tonnes, he said. Delivery on the optional origin wheat would be for May 20-June 10, exporters and the embassy said.
SUNOIL TENDER - The CCC was tendering on May 7 for 3,000 tonnes of U.S. crude sunflower seed oil for export to Mozambique, June 1-20 shipment.
RICE TENDERS - Jordan seeks to buy 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice for delivery in June, traders said. The closing date for offers is May 21.
- Jamaica was tendering for about 3,000 tonnes U.S. rice in bulk under the PL-480 donation program, its U.S. export agent said. The delivery date was set for May 20-June 5.
Offer must be received no later than May 8.

MARKET TALK - USDA said it will donate about 8,000 tonnes of soybean meal to Feed the Children of Larry Jones International Ministries Inc, a private charity, for monetization in Russia. USDA said the donation will be made under its Food for Progress program. The supply period is fiscal year 1997.

... Unusually good weather during February and March will allow India to harvest about 64.5 million tonnes of wheat this season and reduce its imports to 3.5 million tonnes, the U.S. agricultural attache in New Delhi said in a report released Monday.
